Where Mary appeared to three shepherd ch: Harĩa Maria aaonekire harĩ ciana ithatũ iria cĩarĩithagia ng'ondu, Lusia, Fransisko na Jasinta, mwaka wa 1917, akĩhooya mahooya ma Rosari nĩ ũndũ wa thayũ.

Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health: Kanitha Mũnene wa Mũirĩtu Theru Maria wa Ũgima Mwega
Known as the Lourdes of the East, it dra: Kũmenyekaga ta Lourdes ya Irathĩro, nĩ gũkucagia athiĩ a ihooero a mĩtĩkĩre mĩingĩ hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Tamil Nadu, mũno mũno thigũkũ-inĩ yake kĩambĩrĩria-inĩ kĩa Mwere wa kenda.
Basilica of Our Lady of La Vang: Kanitha Mũnene wa Mũirĩtu Theru Maria wa La Vang
Mary is said to have comforted persecute: Kugaga atĩ mwaka wa 1798 Maria nĩaahooreririe Akatholiki arĩa maanyariragwo na maahithĩte mũtitũ-inĩ ũyũ. Nĩkuo kũndũ kwamũre kwa Maria kwa bũrũri wa Vietnam.

Santa María la Real, a Gothic cathedral: Santa María la Real, kanitha mũnene wa Gothic thuutha wa ũthiũ wa tene, itũũra-inĩ inene rĩa ihenya rĩa ndegwa.

A masterpiece of Spanish Gothic and a Wo: Wĩra wa ũũgĩ mũnene wa Gothic wa Spain na Kũndũ kwa Igai rĩa Thĩ. El Cid athikĩtwo rungu rwa nyumba yake nene ya kĩrigũ.

Its cathedral stands beside the Episcopa: Kanitha wayo mũnene ũrũgamĩte hakuhĩ na Nyũmba ya Mbishobu ĩrĩa yathondekirwo nĩ Antoni Gaudí.

A fortress church moved stone by stone u: Kanitha-kĩgo ũrĩa wathamirio ihiga na ihiga ũgatwarwo kĩrĩma-igũrũ rĩrĩa maaĩ ma itangi maahumbĩrire itũũra rĩa tene mĩaka-inĩ ya 1960.
Santiago de Compostela Cathedral: Kanitha Mũnene wa Santiago de Compostela

The four papal basilicas of Rome and oth: Makanitha manene mana ma Papa kũu Roma na makanitha mangĩ manene thĩ
Built over the tomb of Saint Peter, the: Wakirũo igũrũ rĩa mbĩrĩra ya Mũtheru Petero, Papa wa mbere. Michelangelo nĩwe wathondekire nyumba yaguo ya kĩrigũ, na Papa nĩakũngũĩragĩra gũkũ thigũkũ nene cia mwaka.
Archbasilica of Saint John Lateran: Kanitha Mũnene Mũno wa Mũtheru Johana wa Laterano

Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls: Kanitha Mũnene wa Mũtheru Paulo Nja ya Ũthingo

Antoni Gaudí's basilica of the Holy Fami: Kanitha mũnene wa Famĩlĩ Theru wa Antoni Gaudí, ũrĩa ũrakĩo kuuma 1882. Mũthiringo wake wa gatagatĩ wa Jesũ Kristo ũtũmĩte ũtuĩke kanitha ũrĩa mũraihu gũkĩra yothe thĩ.
Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Montmart: Kanitha Mũnene wa Ngoro Theru wa Montmartre

Basilica of Our Lady of Peace: Kanitha Mũnene wa Mũirĩtu Theru Maria wa Thayũ

Keeps the body of Saint Francis Xavier,: Nĩũigĩte mwĩrĩ wa Mũtheru Fransisi Xavier, mũmishonarĩ mũnene wa Ajesuit Asia. Kũndũ kwa Igai rĩa Thĩ Goa ya Tene.
Shelters the image of the Child Jesus th: Nĩũigĩte mbica ya Mwana Jesũ ĩrĩa rũgendo rwa Magellan rwaheanire mwaka wa 1521, kĩririkano kĩamũre kĩa Ũkristiano kĩrĩa kĩa tene mũno Philippines.
Mother churches of the world's great cit: Makanitha-manyina ma matũũra manene ma thĩ

The Duomo, crowned by 135 spires and mor: Duomo, ũrĩa ũrĩ na mĩthũmbĩ 135 na mĩhianano gũkĩra ngiri ithatũ, kanitha ũrĩa mũnene gũkĩra yothe Italia nja ya Vatican.
Santa Maria del Fiore, whose great dome: Santa Maria del Fiore, ũrĩa nyumba yaguo nene ya kĩrigũ ya Filippo Brunelleschi o na rĩu nĩyo nyumba ya kĩrigũ ya matafarĩ nene gũkĩra ciothe iria ciakĩtwo.
The largest Gothic cathedral in the worl: Kanitha mũnene wa Gothic ũrĩa mũnene gũkĩra yothe thĩ, ũrĩ na mũthiringo wa kengele Giralda na mbĩrĩra ya Christopher Columbus.
The primate cathedral of Spain, with El: Kanitha mũnene wa mbere wa Spain, ũrĩ na El Transparente, kĩgongona kĩa Baroque kĩrĩa kĩmũrĩkagio nĩ irima rĩrĩa rĩenjirwo ndenge-inĩ.
The mother church of Catholics in Englan: Kanitha-nyina wa Akatholiki England na Wales, wa matafarĩ matune na mahiga ma mĩhari, thingo ciaguo ikĩhenia na mozaiki.
The neo-Gothic cathedral on Fifth Avenue: Kanitha mũnene wa Gothic mwerũ Fifth Avenue, ũhakanĩrie na Rockefeller Center, gĩtĩ kĩa Mũbishobu Mũnene wa New York.
Metropolitan Cathedral of Mexico City: Kanitha Mũnene Mũno wa Mexico City
The largest cathedral in the Americas, b: Kanitha mũnene ũrĩa mũnene gũkĩra yothe America, ũrĩa wakirũo karine igĩrĩ na nuthu Zócalo, hakuhĩ na mahiga ma tene ma Templo Mayor ya Aaztec.
Oscar Niemeyer's crown of sixteen concre: Thũmbĩ ya Oscar Niemeyer ya itugĩ ikũmi na ithathatũ cia konkiriti. Andĩki ana a Ivanjeli a gĩcango marangagĩra mũrango.
Built of local sandstone, it is the moth: Wakirũo na mahiga ma mũthanga ma kũu, nĩguo kanitha-nyina wa Akatholiki Australia, harĩa Mũthenya wa Andũ Ethĩ wa Thĩ Yothe wekĩirwo mwaka wa 2008.
In Intramuros, the walled city. Rebuilt: Intramuros, itũũra inene rĩrĩa rĩthiũrũrũkĩirio nĩ thingo. Wakirũo rĩngĩ maita manana thuutha wa mwaki, ithingithia rĩa thĩ na mbaara; nĩguo kanitha-nyina wa Philippines.
